p3_b5.ocr: Notably, the rab31 batch is divided into three categories—high, medium, and low—allowing for a nuanced analysis of the impact of dietary composition on key parameters, such as Ra (μm) and Rz (μm). The recorded values for Ra and Rz provide insights into the surface characteristics of the cells under each dietary condition, with the NC diet showing an average Ra of 82.3 ± 4.0 μm and an Rz of 72.0 ± 3.1 μm.

p3_b6.ocr: These metrics are critical for understanding the extent of cellular changes associated with the different diets. Furthermore, the absence of ballooning in the NC diet suggests a potential protective effect, which may warrant further investigation to elucidate the underlying mechanisms and implications for dietary recommendations in related health contexts.
